'''Dwin Wisheel''' was the [[Rayter sector/Legends|Rayter sector's]] [[Fleet Supervisor]] in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. He took delivery of the [[VR-10 Cuirilla-Rayl Xylines-class spacetug|VR-10 ''Cuirilla-Rayl Xylines-''class spacetug]] ''[[Worthless Fool]]'' after it was purchased by a young [[procurement officer]] from [[Yearo Seville]].
